_source: Noms anglais officiels : recettes alignées une à une avec khbbsmelding.com (296/296), capacités et descriptions d'après KHWiki « Abilities (KHBBS) ».

abilityDescriptions.Treasure Magnet: Automatically scoops up nearby prizes for you. Multi-install the ability to increase range.
abilityDescriptions.HP Prize Plus: Increases the number of HP prizes enemies drop. Multi-install the ability for even more prizes.
abilityDescriptions.Link Prize Plus: Increases the number of D-Link prizes enemies drop. Multi-install the ability for even more prizes.
abilityDescriptions.Lucky Strike: Increases the number of prize boxes enemies drop. Multi-install the ability for even more prizes.
abilityDescriptions.HP Boost: Increases your HP. Multi-install the ability to bump it up even further.
abilityDescriptions.Fire Boost: Increases the damage dealt by your Fire commands. Multi-install the ability to deal even more damage.
abilityDescriptions.Blizzard Boost: Increases the damage dealt by your Blizzard commands. Multi-install the ability to deal even more damage.
abilityDescriptions.Thunder Boost: Increases the damage dealt by your Thunder commands. Multi-install the ability to deal even more damage.
abilityDescriptions.Cure Boost: Increases the amount of HP you recover with Cure commands. Multi-install the ability to recover even more.
abilityDescriptions.Item Boost: Increases the effectiveness of recovery item commands. Multi-install the ability for an even larger improvement.
abilityDescriptions.Attack Haste: Shortens the reload time for all attack commands installed in your deck. Multi-install the ability for even quicker reloading.
abilityDescriptions.Magic Haste: Shortens the reload time for all magic commands installed in your deck. Multi-install the ability for even quicker reloading.
abilityDescriptions.Combo F Boost: Increases the damage dealt by the last blow of your combos. Multi-install the ability to deal even more damage.
abilityDescriptions.Finish Boost: Increases the damage dealt by your Finish command. Multi-install the ability to deal even more damage.
abilityDescriptions.Fire Screen: Increases your resistance to Fire attacks. Multi-install the ability to bump it up even further.
abilityDescriptions.Blizzard Screen: Increases your resistance to Blizzard attacks. Multi-install the ability to bump it up even further.
abilityDescriptions.Thunder Screen: Increases your resistance to Thunder attacks. Multi-install the ability to bump it up even further.
abilityDescriptions.Dark Screen: Increases your resistance to darkness-based attacks. Multi-install the ability to bump it up even further.
abilityDescriptions.Reload Boost: Shortens the reload time for all commands installed in your deck whenever your HP falls below 25%.
abilityDescriptions.Defender: Increases your Defense whenever your HP falls below 25%.
abilityDescriptions.Combo Plus: Adds one stroke to your ground combos. Multi-install the ability for even longer combos.
abilityDescriptions.Air Combo Plus: Adds one stroke to your aerial combos. Multi-install the ability for even longer combos.
abilityDescriptions.EXP Chance: Doubles the EXP you receive whenever your HP falls below 25%.
abilityDescriptions.EXP Walker: Awards you 1 EXP for every step you take.
abilityDescriptions.Damage Syphon: Restores some of the Focus Gauge when you take damage.
abilityDescriptions.Second Chance: Ensures you always retain 1 HP after an attack that would otherwise finish you off, unless you are already down to 1 HP.
abilityDescriptions.Once More: Ensures you always retain 1 HP throughout a combo that would otherwise finish you off, unless you are already down to 1 HP when the first attack hits.
abilityDescriptions.Leaf Bracer: Prevents you from taking damage while using Cure commands.
abilityDescriptions.Scan: Displays the HP of the targeted enemy.
abilityDescriptions.Zero EXP: Prevents you from gaining any EXP when you defeat enemies.
